notes.title: Hot fixes 3 - The Post NOA update
notes.notes:
- Fixed incorrect spelling and grammar mistakes throughout.
- Unable for player to click the sparrow icon in certain scenes, that may result in Shouta appearing to randomly talk to himself.
- Fixed issues with certain scenes where Shouta's name tag was shown instead of Ayumi.
-  Watashi Suzume demo has been uploaded and extended from chapter 0 all the way to around the end of chapter 2.
- More bed bugs have been squashed.

This round of hotfixes brought to you by NOA, who finally got around to reviewing the game after being annoyed by us for almost a month.
Special thanks also to our dedicated group of WS game testers.
If any other bugs slipped through, don't hesitate to let us know via our official Discord, or Twitter (X?) 
Cheers, and I hope you all are enjoying our debut title!
